statement: The pinned SDL Switch 2 Pro decoder handles a 64-byte HID input state and emits independent Share, C, right-paddle and left-paddle joystick button slots, a D-pad hat, four calibrated stick axes and digital left/right triggers exposed through joystick axes. It declares dedicated Pro button count and gyro/accelerometer sensors. This is a source-defined SDL joystick shape, not a verified standardized Gamepad mapping or a physical capture.
